name: Fable II
description: Strip the haze, glow and smear from Albion and unlock the frame rate.
notes: Pick the version that matches your console: if Fable II's title update is enabled in Aurora/FSD, choose Title Update.
Changes last until you quit the game. Start 360 LiveMods before launching Fable II every time you play.
credits: punchbrotv - bloom, motion blur, depth of field and fog patches (Xenia)
Title-update ports and the title-update fog fix were made for 360 LiveMods

mods.name: Remove bloom
mods.description: Removes the heavy glowing haze around bright areas while keeping tone mapping, sunbeams and lighting.

mods.name: Remove motion blur
mods.description: Removes the radial blur that smears the screen when you move and turn.

mods.name: Remove depth of field
mods.description: Removes the near and far blur so the whole scene stays sharp.

mods.name: Remove distance fog
mods.description: Removes the constant fog veil over distant scenery. Close mist, sky colour and atmosphere stay.

mods.name: 60 FPS
mods.description: Lifts the 30 FPS cap. Menus and movement feel much smoother; busy areas like Bowerstone will dip below 60.

mods.name: Native 720p (no MSAA)
mods.description: Renders at a true 1280x720 instead of 1120x720 for a sharper image, and turns anti-aliasing off to pay for it.

unavailable.tu: Crashes the game with the title update. Choose Base game to use it.

mods.name: 30 Hz tick rate
mods.description: Doubles the game logic rate for smoother UI and lower input lag.
mods.warning: Crashed when loading into a save during testing. Only enable it if you want to experiment.

unavailable.tu: Not available for the title update.
